# Folio CLI

Build an offline index over your personal note folders.

## Requirements

- Python 3.11 or newer

## Quick Start

```sh
$ folio index ./notes
```

## Behavior Summary

Running `folio index ./notes` scans the specified `./notes` folder and generates a local index file/store on disk. By design, Folio operates entirely locally and never uploads note contents anywhere.

## Exit Codes

- `0` — Indexing completed cleanly.
- Non-zero — An error occurred while reading the directory or writing the local index.

# Folio

Local-only note indexing CLI.

## Prerequisites

- Python 3.11

## Usage Example

```sh
folio index ./notes
```

## Behavior Summary

`folio index ./notes` requires Python 3.11. It processes `./notes` to build a local index and never uploads notes externally. On completion, it exits `0` for success or a non-zero code if an error occurs.

## Exit Status Notes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `0` | Success; local index built |
| Non-zero | Failure during indexing |
